name: blip-raycast
description: Send files, folders, text and your clipboard to your devices and contacts with Blip, and manage transfers.
author: astroboii47
title: Blip

commands.name: send-to-blip
commands.title: Send
commands.subtitle: Blip
commands.description: Pick a device or contact, then send the Finder selection, files, text or your clipboard.

commands.name: send-clipboard
commands.title: Send Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Blip
commands.description: Pick a device or contact and send whatever is on your clipboard: text, copied files or an image.

commands.name: send-selected-finder-item
commands.title: Send Selected Files
commands.subtitle: Blip
commands.description: Pick a device or contact and send the current Finder or File Explorer selection.

commands.name: quick-send-clipboard
commands.title: Quick Send Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Blip
commands.description: Send the clipboard to your Quick Send recipient straight away, without opening a window. Give it a hotkey.

commands.name: quick-send-selected-files
commands.title: Quick Send Selected Files
commands.subtitle: Blip
commands.description: Send the Finder or File Explorer selection to your Quick Send recipient straight away. Give it a hotkey.

commands.name: transfers
commands.title: Manage Transfers
commands.subtitle: Blip
commands.description: Watch transfer progress, accept or decline incoming files, and pause, resume or cancel transfers.

preferences.name: closeAfterSend
preferences.title: After Sending
preferences.label: Close Raycast after a send starts
preferences.description: Close the Raycast window as soon as Blip accepts the transfer. Progress shows in Manage Transfers.

preferences.name: autoAccept
preferences.title: Auto-Accept
preferences.description: Accept files from your own devices and contacts without asking.

preferences.name: saveToPhotos
preferences.title: Save Media to Photos
preferences.description: macOS only. Save received photos and videos to the Photos library.

preferences.name: saveFolder
preferences.title: Save Received Files To
preferences.description: Folder for received files. Leave empty to keep Blip's setting (Downloads by default).

preferences.name: uploadLimitMbps
preferences.title: Sending Speed Limit (Mbps)
preferences.description: Whole number of megabits per second. 0 removes the limit. Leave empty to keep Blip's setting.

preferences.name: downloadLimitMbps
preferences.title: Receiving Speed Limit (Mbps)
preferences.description: Whole number of megabits per second. 0 removes the limit. Leave empty to keep Blip's setting.
